note: Revenue from the current tariff, FY2025-26: one row per consumer category, slab or time-of-day block (rows 13–137); per row the total (fixed + energy + minimum + other charges + regulatory discount, O) and the energy and fixed charges per unit it implies (G, H) — for the reviewer to compare with the tariff order's rate schedule, which is not read yet.  Totals: the revenue (O138) the ARR carries as row 15 (L15), the units sold as row 9, the regulatory discount (N138).

blank_is_zero.why: NPCL leaves a charge blank where a slab has none (a time-of-day block has no fixed charge); its row total (O = J + K + L + M + N) and its column sums read the blanks as zero
